pairs.question: Quanam cognoscitur arte materiem quae terra habeat, ferrique fodinam contineat?
pairs.answer: Norunt pueri, novere bubulci, indicat ipsa soli facies subrufa, nec usquam tam regio infelix ferrum quae non ferat ulla est.
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-posed question and self-answer. Dropped the framing 'Quod si forte roges' ('but if perhaps you ask'), which narrates the asking like 'fortasse requiris'; the question proper is the verbatim interrogative clause 'quanam cognoscitur arte / materiem quae terra habeat, ferrique fodinam / contineat' (lines 208-210), normalized with initial capital and terminal '?'. Stripped leading line-numbers. The answer begins at the operative answering words 'norunt pueri, novere bubulci' (line 210, after the colon) and runs as one contiguous span to the full stop at 'ulla est' (line 212); what follows ('At quae materies solita est excellere, disce', line 213) turns to a new topic, so the window stops there.
